title: Laser or waterjet cutting of perforated bottom plates
description: Laser or waterjet cutting of perforated bottom plates capability for titanium components
processDescription: Abrasive waterjet cutting of titanium uses a high-pressure stream of water mixed with garnet abrasive to erode material. The cold-cutting process produces zero heat-affected zone, ideal for titanium grades sensitive to thermal cracking, specifically for plate. Precision plate for Aerospace, Chemical present unique challenges: Large thin plate (up to 3000 × 1500 × 3 mm) prone to vibration during machining. Vacuum fixture and fly-cutting strategy required.
heatControl: No heat generated - room temperature waterjet stream. HAZ-free process preserves titanium microstructure.
flatnessControl: Large surface area prone to vibration. Vacuum fixture with gasket sealing; fly-cutting strategy with < 0.02 mm flatness over 1000 mm.
capabilitiesDescription: Laser processing capability for Laser or waterjet cutting of perforated bottom plates, with precision beam delivery, gas assist systems, and process monitoring for repeatable quality.
